claimText: Ode to Joy (theme, arranged for beginners): the first two phrases of the theme in C major, melody unchanged, with our own block-chord left hand
outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against the Soprano of Mutopia 528, transposed from G to C. Bars 4 and 8 had the dotted figure (E. D D, D. C C) flattened to two notes, dropping a melody note each; they now follow the source, which the Beginner caps allow, and bar 4's left hand holds the dominant chord through the half cadence. 0 differences in pitch, order, onset and duration; the source matches its MIDI. Still Beginner. The Symphony No. 9 printing is a separate visual check (T100).
